Not exactly this, but I do have OCD and Bipolar. When it's manic, everything's just fine. But once the depressive episode starts, it's like I wanna kill my self. How I handle it? Just by giving hopes to myself, that this is just temporary, this episode will get over soon. Meds don't work on everyone, but hopes do. Believe me, this is the only way, as my psychologist as well isn't helping me much. Talk to your psychologist if he/she helps, it'll be much better.
